title: Movie Recommendation System
description: Built a content-based movie recommendation system using Python and cosine similarity on a Kaggle movie dataset. The app recommends similar movies and displays posters dynamically for a more visual discovery experience.

title: Crypto-InfoSite
description: Developed a dynamic cryptocurrency information web app using React and the CoinGecko API. The platform displays live prices, market trends, and historical data to help users track crypto assets effectively.
